items.headline: OpenAI to merge Chat and Work into one ChatGPT interface with a shared token budget in December
items.summary: Plus, Pro and Business plans will share a single token pool across ChatGPT and Codex starting in December. Chats with Instant models stay unlimited. Users who hit the cap can wait for a reset, upgrade or buy extra credits.
items.why: Merging Chat and Work ends ChatGPT's flat-rate model for heavy users. The shift to a shared token budget aligns OpenAI with the usage-based billing Anthropic already adopted and gives OpenAI a pricing lever as agentic workloads push up costs.

items.headline: OpenAI adds card and device limits on paid ChatGPT subscriptions to curb multi-account sharing
items.summary: ChatGPT Go, Plus and Pro plans now cap how many paid accounts can run on one device or payment card. Logging out does not free a slot. Business, Enterprise and Edu plans are exempt.

items.headline: Anthropic extends text watermark to four more Claude models ahead of the EU AI Act deadline
items.summary: Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 now carry invisible text watermarks. On Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6, changing temperature, top_p or top_k from defaults bypasses the mark.

items.headline: OpenAI plans to use Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data for model training from November 29
items.summary: An email to Trusted Access members said session data previously excluded from training will be used for model improvement. After backlash, OpenAI sent a second email promising a separate opt-out.

items.headline: Federal judge allows NAACP Clean Air Act lawsuit against SpaceXAI Colossus data center to proceed
items.summary: Judge Debra Brown denied SpaceXAI's motion to dismiss, ruling the gas turbines powering the Memphis-area facility are not exempt as mobile sources. The DOJ's earlier dismissal motion was also denied.

items.headline: Google tests a new Gemini 4 Carbon checkpoint on Chatbot Arena
items.summary: TestingCatalog spotted a new Gemini 4 Carbon checkpoint appearing on LMArena. Google has not officially announced this checkpoint, which follows the earlier Gemini 4 Argon release.

items.headline: Anthropic updates Claude Code to discourage recreating specific existing games
items.summary: A new system prompt rule tells Claude Opus 5.5 not to build a copy of a specific existing game, even if renamed. Original games and genre projects still work. An Anthropic spokesperson confirmed the change.

items.headline: Researchers chain ChatGPT sandbox flaws into a full account-takeover attack, OpenAI pays $5,000
items.summary: Parameter Labs found that a MathLive message handler let sandboxed HTML preview frames inject content into ChatGPT's parent page. Combined with a YouTube oEmbed CSP bypass, a crafted share link could steal user data. OpenAI patched the flaw.
